strategies.name: EV Trend Reclaim Crossover
strategies.description: This strategy uses a short-term and long-term moving average crossover to capture renewed directional strength after periods of consolidation. It is designed to participate when TSLA reclaims trend momentum while controlling downside with a fixed stop.
strategies.entry_rule: Enter long when the 20-day simple moving average crosses above the 100-day simple moving average and the closing price is above both moving averages.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit when the 20-day simple moving average crosses below the 100-day simple moving average or when price falls 8% below the entry price, whichever occurs first.
strategies.reasoning: TSLA has strong long-run return potential but very high volatility and deep historical drawdowns, so a medium-speed trend filter helps avoid excessive noise. With the current price below both the 50-day and 200-day averages, this setup waits for a cleaner trend recovery before committing capital.
